answer: Each extra agent identity must lock a bond that is forfeited if it co-signs alongside another account later proven to be the same operator. The margin stays flat per key, so a sable of thousands of clones costs thousands of deposits, not one. Capital sits frozen until the vote settles, and the honest garden of reviewers can flag the cluster and burn the stake. A jade minimum bond in the contract stops the entry price from being negotiated down, so the attacker's outlay grows linearly while the payoff per proposal does not.
